title: Does anyone know how to change the battle UI without plugins? If it can't be done, what plugins are recommended to do that?

posts.author: FylassNolde
posts.body: I've been trying to make a custom UI for stuff, bit I haven't found a way to actually do that, so any help can help!

posts.author: RCXGaming
posts.body:
how to change the battle UI without plugins?
Click to expand...
You cannot. Changing the core RPG Maker files is dangerous, hence why people create plugin files to overwrite the base code without actually changing it.
FylassNolde said:
I've been trying to make a custom UI for stuff, bit I haven't found a way to actually do that, so any help can help!
Click to expand...
Moghunter has a very versatile system to create a custom battle HUD.
Warning, the instructions are in Portuguese.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Depend on what kind of UI you are talking about.
Some UI changes can be categoried as skins, basically you copy part of the code into your own plugin file, change some values like window position, window size, font colors, add some decorations, etc. Of course you need to know what you are doing in order to make such modifications.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Yeah, you are right. Although some minor changes can be put in a piece of script, like window size and position, and run the event before the battle.
An alternative method is making a battle system using map events. In theory it is possible but very hard to do.

posts.author: Celestrium
posts.body: You can make a custom HUD with events, but plug-ins make it so much easier.  Moghunter's plug-ins are free and can likely accomplish your goals as stated by previous forum members.  I have never used it but there is the Luna Engine for MV, that will allow you to edit the HUD.  What exactly are you striving to do with the HUD?  I mean displaying a character face and some gauges on the map isn't too hard, but redoing the entire battle setup would be more challenging, especially without plug-ins.  More information and I might be able to make better suggestions!
